objects.label: flag
objects.reason: Three independent readers, three separate dispatches on one crop, all answered 'flag with heart' and all were sure. The intended object is a flag on a pole and the heart is what is printed on it at that instant, so every read names the container AND its content: score the idea, not the noun (2026-09-06). Zero readers named a different thing, three of three reached it, three clean sure reads.
